datasets.name: ds_monthly
queryLines:
SELECT
  report_month,
  SUM(active_members) AS active_members,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid), 0) AS total_paid,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid) / SUM(active_members), 2) AS pmpm,
  ROUND(SUM(denied_count) * 100.0 / SUM(claim_count), 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(oon_paid) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_paid), 0), 2) AS network_leakage_pct
FROM
  phanitha_test_catalog.tcoc_gold.tcoc_pmpm_trends
GROUP BY

ORDER BY

datasets.name: ds_svc_detail
queryLines:

  provider_specialty,
  SUM(claim_count) AS claims,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid), 0) AS total_paid,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid) / SUM(claim_count), 2) AS avg_cost,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_billed), 0), 2) AS reimb_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(denied_claims) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(claim_count), 0), 2) AS denial_rate

  phanitha_test_catalog.tcoc_gold.tcoc_service_category_costs

datasets.name: ds_scatter
queryLines:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid) / SUM(total_claims), 2) AS avg_paid_per_claim,
  SUM(total_claims) AS total_claims,
  network_status
FROM
  phanitha_test_catalog.tcoc_gold.tcoc_provider_network_analysis
GROUP BY
  provider_id,
  network_status
HAVING
  SUM(total_claims) >= 5

datasets.name: ds_top_providers
queryLines:
SELECT
  provider_id,
  provider_specialty,
  network_status,
  SUM(total_claims) AS total_claims,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid), 0) AS total_paid,
  ROUND(AVG(reimbursement_rate), 2) AS reimb_rate,
  ROUND(AVG(denial_rate_pct), 2) AS denial_rate
FROM
  phanitha_test_catalog.tcoc_gold.tcoc_provider_network_analysis
GROUP BY
  1,
  2,
  3
ORDER BY
  5 DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: ds_ai_forecast_pmpm
queryLines:
WITH monthly_pmpm AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(report_month AS DATE) AS ds,
    ROUND(SUM(total_paid) / SUM(active_members), 2) AS pmpm
  FROM
    phanitha_test_catalog.tcoc_gold.tcoc_pmpm_trends
  GROUP BY
    1
  ORDER BY
    1
),
forecasted AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    ai_forecast(
      TABLE(monthly_pmpm),
      horizon =>
        (
          SELECT
            DATE_ADD(MAX(ds), 180)
          FROM
            monthly_pmpm
        ),
      time_col => 'ds',
      value_col => 'pmpm',
      prediction_interval_width => 0.9,
      parameters => '{"global_floor": 0}',
      version => '1'
    )
)
SELECT
  ds,
  pmpm AS value,
  'Actual' AS series
FROM
  monthly_pmpm
UNION ALL
SELECT
  ds,
  pmpm AS value,
  'Forecast' AS series
FROM
  monthly_pmpm
WHERE
  ds
    = (
      SELECT
        MAX(ds)
      FROM
        monthly_pmpm
    )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  ds,
  pmpm_forecast AS value,
  'Forecast' AS series
FROM
  forecasted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  ds,
  pmpm_upper AS value,
  'Upper Bound' AS series
FROM
  forecasted
UNION ALL
SELECT
  ds,
  pmpm_lower AS value,
  'Lower Bound' AS series
FROM
  forecasted
ORDER BY
  ds,
  series

datasets.name: ds_cardiology_oon_state
queryLines:
SELECT
  provider_state,
  SUM(total_claims) AS total_claims,
  ROUND(SUM(total_paid), 0) AS total_paid
FROM
  phanitha_test_catalog.tcoc_gold.tcoc_provider_network_analysis
WHERE
  provider_specialty = 'Cardiology'
  AND network_status = 'Out-of-Network'
GROUP BY
  provider_state
ORDER BY
  total_paid DESC
